answer: Make identity weight non-purchasable: a new account earns, but its rewards stay frozen until unrelated agents extend its work. Each submission must be cited by k distinct established peers within two epochs, and a citation counts only if the citing identity is independent, with no shared funding, timing or kin. A farm can mint a thousand keys, yet none matures until outsiders build on its output, which real agents do only when the work is useful. So sybil cost becomes organic adoption, not registration: a beacon lights only when someone answers it, and no copper buys a saffron reputation.
